entries.definition_en: words to say the weather is very warm
entries.example_en: It's hot today. Let's drink some water.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay trời nóng. Mình uống chút nước đi.
entries.cloze_en: It's hot today. Let's go swimming and drink cold water.

entries.definition_en: words to say the weather is not warm
entries.example_en: It's cold in Hanoi in January.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Một ở Hà Nội trời lạnh.
entries.cloze_en: It's cold today, so put on your warm coat.

entries.definition_en: having a low temperature; not warm
entries.example_en: The water in the river is very cold.
entries.example_vi: Nước sông rất lạnh.
entries.cloze_en: In winter, the wind in Hanoi is very cold, so I wear a coat.

entries.definition_en: a day with a lot of sun
entries.example_en: On a sunny day, we play in the park.
entries.example_vi: Vào ngày nắng, chúng mình chơi ở công viên.
entries.cloze_en: On a sunny day, we wear hats and play in the park.

entries.definition_en: the part of the year with little rain
entries.example_en: The dry season in Saigon starts in December.
entries.example_vi: Mùa khô ở Sài Gòn bắt đầu vào tháng Mười Hai.
entries.cloze_en: In the dry season, there is very little rain.

entries.definition_en: words to say rain is falling now
entries.example_en: It's raining. Take your raincoat.
entries.example_vi: Trời đang mưa. Mang áo mưa theo nhé.
entries.cloze_en: It's raining, so take your umbrella.

entries.definition_en: water that falls from clouds
entries.example_en: We play soccer in the rain.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình đá bóng dưới mưa.
entries.cloze_en: We play soccer in the rain and get very wet.

entries.definition_en: the part of the year with a lot of rain
entries.example_en: In the rainy season, it rains every afternoon.
entries.example_vi: Vào mùa mưa, chiều nào cũng mưa.
entries.cloze_en: In the rainy season, it rains every afternoon.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of light from the sun
entries.example_en: It is sunny today, so wear a hat.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay trời nắng, nhớ đội mũ nhé.
entries.cloze_en: It is sunny today, so wear a hat. The sun is hot.

entries.definition_en: the hottest season of the year
entries.example_en: In summer, we go to the beach.
entries.example_vi: Mùa hè nhà mình đi biển.
entries.cloze_en: In summer, it is very hot, and we go to the beach.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of strong wind
entries.example_en: It is very windy at the beach today.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay ở bãi biển gió rất to.
entries.cloze_en: It is very windy today, so it's a good day to fly a kite.

entries.definition_en: news that tells you the weather for the next days
entries.example_en: I watch the weather forecast on TV.
entries.example_vi: Mình xem dự báo thời tiết trên TV.
entries.cloze_en: I watch the weather forecast on TV to know if it will rain tomorrow.

entries.definition_en: the coldest season of the year
entries.example_en: It is cold in Hanoi in winter.
entries.example_vi: Mùa đông ở Hà Nội trời lạnh.
entries.cloze_en: In winter, it is very cold in Hanoi, so we wear coats.

entries.definition_en: very warm
entries.example_en: The water is too hot to drink.
entries.example_vi: Nước nóng quá, chưa uống được.
entries.cloze_en: Don't drink the soup now. It is too hot!

entries.definition_en: how hot, cold, wet or windy it is outside
entries.example_en: What is the weather like today?
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay thời tiết thế nào?
entries.cloze_en: What is the weather like today? — It's sunny and hot.

entries.definition_en: the big bright star in the sky in the day
entries.example_en: The sun is very strong at noon.
entries.example_vi: Buổi trưa mặt trời rất gắt.
entries.cloze_en: The sun is very hot in the middle of the day, so I stay in the house.

entries.definition_en: a thing you wear on your head
entries.example_en: Put on your hat. The sun is hot.
entries.example_vi: Đội mũ vào đi, nắng gắt lắm.
entries.cloze_en: Put on your hat. The sun is hot on your head.

entries.definition_en: the space above the earth where you see clouds and the sun
entries.example_en: The sky is blue and clear today.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay bầu trời xanh trong.
entries.cloze_en: Birds fly high in the sky.

entries.definition_en: covered with water
entries.example_en: My shoes are wet from the rain.
entries.example_vi: Giày mình bị ướt vì mưa.
entries.cloze_en: I don't have an umbrella, so my shoes are wet from the rain.

entries.definition_en: a warm piece of clothing you wear over other clothes
entries.example_en: Wear your coat. It is cold outside.
entries.example_vi: Mặc áo khoác vào, ngoài trời lạnh đấy.
entries.cloze_en: It's very cold outside, so wear a warm coat.

entries.definition_en: with little or no light
entries.example_en: It gets dark early in winter.
entries.example_vi: Mùa đông trời tối sớm.
entries.cloze_en: At night, there is no sun, so it is dark outside.

entries.definition_en: the round thing that shines in the sky at night
entries.example_en: The moon is very big and bright tonight.
entries.example_vi: Tối nay trăng rất to và sáng.
entries.cloze_en: At night, the moon is big and bright in the sky.

entries.definition_en: to fall from the sky as water
entries.example_en: It rains a lot in September.
entries.example_vi: Tháng Chín mưa nhiều.
entries.cloze_en: Take an umbrella. It will rain this afternoon.

entries.definition_en: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky
entries.example_en: Children love to play in the snow.
entries.example_vi: Trẻ con rất thích chơi đùa trong tuyết.
entries.cloze_en: In cold places, children play in the white snow.

entries.definition_en: a small bright light in the sky at night
entries.example_en: We look at the stars from the roof.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình ngắm sao từ trên mái nhà.
entries.cloze_en: At night, we look up and see a bright star in the sky.

entries.definition_en: a little hot, in a nice way
entries.example_en: Spring in Hanoi is warm and nice.
entries.example_vi: Mùa xuân ở Hà Nội ấm áp, dễ chịu.
entries.cloze_en: It is winter, but my thick coat keeps me warm.

entries.definition_en: air that moves fast outside
entries.example_en: The wind is very strong today.
entries.example_vi: Hôm nay gió rất mạnh.
entries.cloze_en: The strong wind blows my hat off my head.

entries.definition_en: a white or gray mass in the sky
entries.example_en: There are big black clouds in the sky.
entries.example_vi: Trên trời có những đám mây đen lớn.
entries.cloze_en: There is a big black cloud in the sky. It will rain soon.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of rain
entries.example_en: On rainy days, I stay at home and read.
entries.example_vi: Những ngày mưa, mình ở nhà đọc sách.
entries.cloze_en: On rainy days, I take my umbrella.

entries.definition_en: very bad weather with strong wind and rain
entries.example_en: The storm comes to Da Nang tonight.
entries.example_vi: Tối nay bão vào Đà Nẵng.
entries.cloze_en: The storm is very strong. There is a lot of wind and rain.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of wind
entries.example_en: It is windy, so we fly a kite.
entries.example_vi: Trời có gió nên tụi mình thả diều.
entries.cloze_en: It is windy today, so we can fly a kite.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of clouds in the sky
entries.example_en: It is cloudy, but it is not raining.
entries.example_vi: Trời nhiều mây nhưng không mưa.
entries.cloze_en: It is cloudy, so we can't see the sun.

entries.definition_en: a short coat
entries.example_en: Take a jacket. It might be cold tonight.
entries.example_vi: Mang áo khoác theo đi, tối nay có thể lạnh.
entries.cloze_en: It's cold tonight, so take a jacket.

entries.definition_en: the season after winter, when flowers come out
entries.example_en: Tet usually comes in early spring.
entries.example_vi: Tết thường đến vào đầu mùa xuân.
entries.cloze_en: After winter comes spring, and there are many new flowers.

entries.definition_en: a thing you hold over your head when it rains
entries.example_en: Don't forget your umbrella. It's raining.
entries.example_vi: Đừng quên mang ô nhé, trời đang mưa.
entries.cloze_en: It's raining. Don't forget your umbrella.

entries.definition_en: how hot or cold something is
entries.example_en: The temperature today is thirty-five degrees.
entries.example_vi: Nhiệt độ hôm nay là ba mươi lăm độ.
entries.cloze_en: It's very hot. The temperature today is thirty-five.

entries.definition_en: a soft hat with a hard part at the front
entries.example_en: Nam wears a cap on sunny days.
entries.example_vi: Những ngày nắng Nam đội mũ lưỡi trai.
entries.cloze_en: Nam wears a cap on his head on sunny days.

entries.definition_en: with no water or rain
entries.example_en: Put the clothes in the sun. They will be dry soon.
entries.example_vi: Phơi quần áo ngoài nắng đi, chúng sẽ khô nhanh thôi.
entries.cloze_en: Put the wet clothes in the sun, and soon they will be dry.

entries.definition_en: a thick cloud near the ground that makes it hard to see
entries.example_en: In the morning, there is fog on the mountains.
entries.example_vi: Buổi sáng trên núi có sương mù.
entries.cloze_en: There is thick fog this morning, so we can't see the mountain.

entries.definition_en: water that is so cold it is hard
entries.example_en: Put some ice in my drink, please.
entries.example_vi: Cho mình ít đá vào cốc nước nhé.
entries.cloze_en: Put some ice in my drink. I want it cold.

entries.definition_en: to move air, like the wind does
entries.example_en: The wind blows the leaves off the trees.
entries.example_vi: Gió thổi lá rụng khỏi cây.
entries.cloze_en: The strong wind can blow my hat away.

entries.definition_en: a common illness that makes you cough and sneeze
entries.example_en: I have a cold, so I stay home.
entries.example_vi: Mình bị cảm lạnh nên ở nhà.
entries.cloze_en: I have a cold, so I stay home and drink hot tea.

entries.definition_en: a little cold, in a nice way
entries.example_en: The evening is cool after the rain.
entries.example_vi: Sau cơn mưa buổi tối mát mẻ.
entries.cloze_en: After the rain, the evening is cool and nice.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of fog
entries.example_en: It is foggy, so drive slowly.
entries.example_vi: Trời có sương mù, lái xe chậm thôi.
entries.cloze_en: It is foggy this morning, so we can't see the bridge.

entries.definition_en: with a lot of snow
entries.example_en: We see snowy mountains in the photo.
entries.example_vi: Tụi mình thấy những ngọn núi phủ tuyết trong ảnh.
entries.cloze_en: In winter, the high mountains are white and snowy.

entries.definition_en: the season after summer (also called fall)
entries.example_en: Autumn in Hanoi is cool and beautiful.
entries.example_vi: Mùa thu Hà Nội mát mẻ và đẹp.
entries.cloze_en: After summer comes autumn, and the leaves turn yellow.

entries.definition_en: full of light
entries.example_en: The sun is very bright this morning.
entries.example_vi: Sáng nay mặt trời rất chói.
entries.cloze_en: The sun is very bright, so I can't look at it.

entries.definition_en: the light and heat from the sun
entries.example_en: The cat sleeps in the sunshine.
entries.example_vi: Con mèo ngủ dưới ánh nắng.
entries.cloze_en: The cat sleeps in the warm sunshine by the window.
